lines.en: I decide to spend the end of the school day at the pool with Ayane instead of being responsible and utilizing these hours to pretend to be a guidance counselor instead.
It is not the most mature decision I have made, particularly because the amount of latex in this room directly impacted my decision to come here, but I suppose that doesn’t really matter right now.
If Ayane really is trying to face the world with a renewed lease on life and that same level of optimism she had when I first started having sex with her, I owe it to her to reciprocate that.
Not the optimism, of course. Or the happiness either as I’m pretty sure I’m almost entirely incapable of showing either of those traits.
But what I will reciprocate is a level of focus that miraculously evades the many asses in this room and hones in on her instead.
We have each other. And we will continue to have each other in every way until one of our brains turn into goo or our memories are wiped clean like the world’s most complicated dry-erase board.
Everything begins to spin again.
Just this time, it’s in a way that doesn’t make us dizzy.
: ...and that’s how I wound up freeing all of the lobsters in Kumon-mi from the tyranny of those evil grocery stores.
: Admirable story, Ayane. I particularly enjoyed the part with the bowling tournament.
: I don’t know how I could have accomplished my goal without that. But that’s enough about my Tuesday- we can talk about more interesting stuff now.
: More interesting than lobster liberation? That’s a pretty big ask. I’m not sure if I’ll be able to contribute in a meaningful way.
: Well...Halloween’s right around the corner. We could always talk about that? That should be pretty interesting-ish, right?
: I still haven’t decided what I’m going to dress up as this year. Maybe you can help me brainstorm or something?
: Giving me full control over what you wear is a dangerous thing to do, Ayane.
: If Chika can dress up as a sex-dog, I’m pretty sure that anything you want to put me in will work out just fine.
: Then I will ask that you also dress up as a sex-dog this year. Even if I’m pretty confident there’s a better name for whatever costume that was.
: I will see what I can do. But keep in mind that I’m not exactly known for risque costumes like that.
: I can see why. They don’t really fit your personality.
: You think so?
: Yeah. For a hypersexual teen who has now had threesomes with two of her classmates, you’re extremely wholesome. It’s kind of weird actually.
: The first threesome didn’t count. And yeah, it’s probably a little harder to call me wholesome now that you’ve watched me suck your jizz out of the sex-dog’s mouth.
: Is Chika just permanently “the sex-dog” now?
: Sure. I think it fits her pretty well.
: Yeah. For a hypersexual teen coming off of her first threesome, you’re extremely wholesome. It’s kind of weird actually.
: Yeah, it’s probably a little harder to call me wholesome now that you’ve watched me suck your jizz out of the sex-dog’s mouth.
: Is Chika just permanently “the sex-dog” now?
: Sure. I think it fits her pretty well.
: Yeah, for a hypersexual teen who’s let me cum inside her more times than I can count, you’re surprisingly wholesome. It’s kind of weird actually.
: Thanks. I think.
: That was a compliment, right?
: Sure. Why not?

: In regard to your actual Halloween costume, though- just do whatever you want. I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t a fan of the group cosplay stuff you guys have done the last couple years, so that’s always welcome.
: I’ll be happy as long as you don’t pull a Maya and go to whatever party we’re having this year dressed up as me.
: Aww, but I think I’d look really cute in your clothes.
: Ayane, I might be a narcissist. But even I don’t want to have sex with myself.
: Yeah, but that’s only because you have a penis. If you didn’t, you’d be all over yourself. And I’d also probably become bisexual.
: I’m just going to warn you now. If I come home one of these days and find you in my closet, I am not going to be happy.

: Really? I can’t even borrow a big shirt to sleep in or something? Wouldn’t it be nice seeing me in an oversized t-shirt the night after sleeping over while I cook you breakfast? I think that sounds nice.
: I’m sure it would be very nice in the ten seconds before Ami chops your head off.
: Ami won’t do anything to me. I’m safe and free to do anything I please and nobody can stop me. That’s Ayane 2.0’s whole thing. Remember?

: Can you teach me whatever this mysterious anti-Ami method of yours is next? Because, even if she’s been easing up lately, I still feel like it’ll come in handy knowing how you’re keeping her at bay.
: I’m keeping her at bay with the power of friendship of course.
: Ayane-
: Didn’t I already tell you that was a secret? Just accept my safety and go back to telling me what sort of costumes you want to make love to me in.
: My confidence has taken a beating over the last year and I could really use the boost.
: I would have sex with you no matter what you’re wearing.
: Dolphin costume it is.
: Wouldn’t be the first time I’ve had sex with someone who’s been in that thing.
: You had sex with Sana?! When?! She wasn’t on the list! Also, how?!
: Not Sana, Niki. She was the one in the costume last year.
: Niki was the mystery-dolphin? But why would she-
: Wait, Niki wasn’t on the list either. At least...not in the sex column.
: That...is a relatively new development.
: So...you and your long-time ex-girlfriend who is not only very famous, but your childhood-friend...are together again?
: If you’re worried, you shouldn’t be. I don’t plan on leaving you any time soon.
: Is there...anyone else you’ve added to the list since writing it? Should I grab you another pen and paper?
: There...
: There is.
: Hah...Okay. Hit me. Who is it this time?
: It’s Nodoka.
: Tch. So she’s not all talk after all.
: She’s...different, though.
: Considering who we’re talking about, that could mean a number of things.
: What I mean is that I don’t really feel anything for her. It’s just sort of a thing that happened.
: As in you both accidentally got naked and slipped and your penis wound up inside of her vagina?
: I actually kind of wish it did go down like that. That would be way easier to...accept and understand.
: I’m...confused. But, at the risk of learning more details and tarnishing my happiness, I say we just get back to the topic at hand.
: Fine. Where’d we leave off again? Something about having sex with Sana?
: Almost. We were talking about Halloween before we got sidetracked by another sex-animal.
: Right, right. Any word on where this year’s party will be? We haven’t been to your place in a while. Maybe that will work?
: There’s no word on that just yet. But I’ve actually been thinking it might be fun if we do our own thing this year too. After the party, I mean.
: Just you and me?
: And the other members of the Love Squad. Sana too if you can promise not to have sex with her.
: Do I have to?
: Only if you want her to maintain the feeling in her lower body.
: I’ll have to get back to you on that.

: What do you think, though? Is that something you’d be interested in? We could do it at your place or...maybe the karaoke lounge? I don’t know. I just kind of feel like trying something a little different.
: The big group parties are fun and all, but something a bit more intimate sounds like it would be way more enjoyable for me on a personal level. And I’m sure Sana would agree.
: Fine by me. We’ll just have to think of a way to get me away from everyone else since I’m kind of the center of attention at all of our group outings.
: Well, all things considered, it’ll definitely be easier than it would have been last year. I’m sure we’ll think of something.
: Just let me know. We’ll call breaking away from the other girls for a second party one of my first steps toward adopting this new carefree outlook you seem to have on life.
: Follow me into the light, Sensei. For only I can show you what it means to be free.
: Is that...a Yasu impression?
: Pretty good, right? I’ve been practicing.
: Why?
: I figure that if I get good enough at imitating all of the other girls that you won’t have a reason to have sex with any of them anymore.
: That was a joke. I’m not being serious.
: I never really know with you.
: Hey, I’ve gotten pretty good at suppressing my crazy side.
: That’s what I thought until you gave me an exact duplicate of my phone, complete with all of my contacts and wallpaper.
: Pretty good doesn’t mean “perfect.” I still have my flaws. I’m just a little better at not showing them now. But again, this will continue to improve with every cycle.
: Ayane 2.0 is here not just to stay, but to be the backbone everyone needs when confronting this big, scary world we find ourselves in.
: Well, keep it up and even Maya might be smiling soon enough.
: Actually, I’m glad you brought her up- because I’ve been meaning to ask you something.
: I know Ami’s changes are kind of obvious because of this whole “Stop suffocating me” policy you’re starting to enforce, but...don’t you think Maya’s been acting a little different lately too?
: Different how?
: Well, for one, she asked me if I needed a hug the other day.
: You’re right. That is very concerning.
: It’s not just that either, but...it’s kind of hard to describe. She just feels kind of off. Did anything happen with you two?
: Apart from the near-kiss? Not really. Maybe her...real personality is just starting to leak out or something?

: She’s had to keep a brave face on for what I can only imagine is an absurd amount of time. We can’t really fault her if that mask starts to crack now that she’s starting to feel a little more comfortable.
: I guess you’re right. There’s no way of knowing how either one of us would feel in her shoes, so...it could just be normal character development or something.
: She’s just been the same old Maya for so long though that I can’t help but worry any time she does something even slightly different.
: Either way, you know her better than I do. So I’ll just take your word for it.
: I wouldn’t say I know her any better than you. Just that I have a higher chance of making out with her.
: Is it the same for Miku as well? Because I’ve noticed she hasn’t been acting like herself lately either.
: I...might have an idea as to why. But, for clarity’s sake, what do you mean?
: Well, for one, she’s not running around and screaming.
: In fact, I can’t even tell if she’s awake right now.
: I know Imani and Makoto have been cracking down on the girls with lower grades lately. And come to think of it, I'm pretty sure that’s why Makoto isn’t here today.
: Do you think this might have something to do with that?
: It...could.
Or it could be something completely different that I shouldn’t bother Ayane about as it has nothing to do with her...
: Hey, Miku. Are you awake over there? Aren’t you going to swim today?
: Maybe she really is asleep?
: Should we...just let her rest? She probably needs it if it’s from overworking herself, right? I can’t imagine all those worksheets are doing her any favors.
: Uhh...
: Actually, I’m going to let someone who’s better at this sort of thing deal with it. I think this might be a little more than just...being overworked.
: More how? Do you know what’s going on?
Leaving Ayane on the bench, I make my way over to the girl who is inarguably the most mature person in this room.
: Karin, have you talked to Miku today?
: Hm? I did earlier. Why do you ask?
: She’s just...
: She looks a little out of it right now, don’t you think?
: Out of it how? What’s-
: Wait, is she asleep? During club?
: I was beginning to wonder why it’s been so quiet all day...I suppose that explains it.
: Sorry, Nodoka. I’ll be back in a second. I’m just gonna go check up on her really quick.
Karin leaves Nodoka’s side, prompting Ayane to get off the bench and head over toward me as the lot of us move closer to Miku.
